A complete answer must start with measurable quality, latency, throughput, cost, privacy, and freshness targets. Then trace data from collection through training, offline evaluation, serving, monitoring, feedback, and rollback. Quantify the main bottleneck and explain the tradeoff behind each component instead of listing technologies.

Read “Making Deep Learning Go Brrrr From First Principles” first for the intuition. Then use “Triton: Fused Softmax” to check implementation details, tradeoffs, or failure modes.
